versions.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly find and prioritize freelance and independent talent on Twitter/X by skill area.

- Searches Twitter for freelancers, solopreneurs, and independent contractors using skill and availability keywords
- Returns handle, name, skill set (from bio), client/work signals, follower metrics, and availability status
- Designed for agencies, project managers, and operators needing on-demand specialists
- Output prioritizes open-to-work and active candidates; includes scoring and edge case handling
- Supports CLI, REST API, and Apify workflow usage
